text:
Marathon Petroleum rose 1.46% today, continuing a 3.77% climb over two weeks as oil markets tightened and geopolitical tensions escalated. U.S. crude is trading at $83.90 a barrel while global oil hit $88.24, and U.S. refineries are running at 97.4% capacity—near maximum utilization. This combination of tight crude supplies and high refinery demand is favorable for refiners like Marathon, which benefit when they can process abundant volumes at favorable margins.

The recent headlines around Iran sanctions and U.S.-Iran tensions appear to have underpinned the broader sector strength. Treasury sanctions on banks facilitating Iran's trade, along with escalating geopolitical rhetoric, have kept oil prices elevated and created supply uncertainty that supports refiner margins—especially when, as now, U.S. refineries are running hot to keep up with demand.
